tasks.title: Celeste and Brennan Whitford · 2025 Form 1040
tasks.description: Prepare the 2025 Form 1040 for Celeste and Brennan Whitford, married filing jointly in Washington, from 10 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Tie Celeste's HANGS W-2 and dividends to the company's payroll and the board's 2025 dividends, apply the 2025 SALT limit as it phases down, itemize mortgage interest and acknowledged gifts, tax the qualified dividends through the worksheet, add Additional Medicare Tax and the net investment income tax, test AMT and the underpayment penalty, and apply withholding, the Additional Medicare Tax the employer withheld and the estimated payments the IRS credits to 2025. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an unsigned draft. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an unsigned draft Form 1040 PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Unsigned draft, not reviewed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. Both spouses sign and a person files.
